description: Beneath the twisted canopy of the Tuzari Wilds rests the heart of the jungle’s corruption. Ages ago, the old empires sacrificed one hundred holy martyrs to forge a colossal blade called the Demonbrand. With it, they impaled the demon lord Baphumos, trapping his body and hunger in stone. Now the Prophet Ez’rath leads the Urrak into the ruins, offering blood and prayer to awaken the demon once more.

Under the cold light of the moon, the dunes of the Empyrean Sands shift and whisper. From beneath their surface, the Sin-Magir rises once more, the Augur of the Stars reborn in deathless form. His followers gather beneath the constellations, drawn to a celestial relic capable of restoring their ancient empire.

Beneath the jagged peaks of the Godfall Mountains, a hidden quarry pulses with unnatural light. The Nezari Elves have begun a relentless mining operation deep within the stone, tearing blood-red crystals from the earth in a frenzy. Their reasons remain cloaked in secrecy, but the brutality of their methods is plain to see. The Nezari prepare for war.

To the frozen south, high atop the Ael'deth Mountain, lies the hidden prison of Al’zerac, an ancient frost wyrm. For centuries, the Eldrin have guarded the vault, but time wears down both vigilance and faith. Cithrel now walks the outer wards, her power cracking ancient seals that once bound the Great Wyrm. When the final lock breaks, Al’zerac will rise again, not as a god to be worshiped but as a weapon to restore the Eldrin’s ancient dominion.

Beneath the ice-choked peaks of the Ael’deth Mountains, an ancient power stirs. Frozen halls tremble as the last egg of Al’zerac’s brood pulses with life once thought extinguished. The cruel Apostate Veras leads his cult through the shattered caverns, seeking to harness the wyrmling’s power.

The outpost of Regath festers with decay. The land it stands upon is soaked with the blood of fallen warriors; betrayed by a Heskyr acolyte, slain in a forgotten battle, for an unholy cause. Now their restless spirits are bound to the land by the unnatural magics of the lost Blood Reliquary, hidden in the crypt beneath.

Hoping to extract the blood from within, the Heskyr have mounted an offensive on the keep's inner sanctum. They have stormed the crumbling walls with ease and now seek to unleash the dormant power, awaking the anger and hate of the unquiet dead.

In the radiant heart of Farvalaan, the Everdawn Grove blooms with golden grass and violet petals that shimmer beneath eternal sunlight. Now, shadows creep among the roots. Malgut, chieftain of the beastmen, seeks salvation for his tribe and instead finds corruption. Whispering voices promise him power, and the bloodstone crystals that grow from the soil pulse in answer. These once noble changelings call to Akari, the Dawn Lord, a great spirit who presides over Farvalaan's sunlit groves.

A dark storm churns above the cliffs beyond Stronghold, where the arrogant orc Warlord Brogg channels thunder and fury. His raiders gather like wolves at the gate, ready to tear down the walls and claim the fort for themselves. Brogg must be made an example to prove to all other would-be bandits and raiders that the Stronghold will not be easily taken.

The holy vault of Wraithtide sleeps beneath a tropical isle, its location guarded by generations of fearful villagers. Within lies the spirit of Bael’Aurum, a demon whose hunger for gold once drowned empires in ruin. The seal now weakens as undead pirates scour the island, led by the Deathless Katrine, who seeks to claim the demon’s treasure and power.

Built at the zenith of the first Heskyrian Dynasty, the Blood Monolith served as the altar of their magic, where rituals of untold power were performed that cast doom on the world and ensured the Heskyr retained their stranglehold. After the dynasty fell, its dormant magics still protected this seat of power, and to this day, no soul who entered has ever emerged.

Now the Heskry rise again and the altars of Xul are stirring within the tower where only screams escape.

Across the endless sea lies an island shaped like a wound upon the world. Its cliffs rise in a hollow ring, surrounding a chasm that descends into endless black. From within, a haunting song drifts across the waters, luring sailors to their doom.

Beneath the waves, the Sea Witch Sinthara stirs. Her voice binds the dead, her wings blot the sky, and her call grows stronger with every ship that shatters on the rocks. Soon, her song will reach beyond the horizon, calling all who sail into her grasp.

From atop their ancient towers, the Scryers of old looked down on the little people of the world and peered into the deepest of their secrets. Through their arcane devices, they gained incredible insight for centuries, not least the location of the Blood Reliquaries, thought lost at the downfall of the first Heskyrian Dynasty, thousands of years ago.

Now the resurgent Heskyr lay siege to the ruined tower, seeking the long-lost knowledge of the Scryers; the final locations of the last remaining Blood Reliquaries that will bring about the triumphant resurgence of the Blood Order.

The eastern road connecting the Vidahlian capital to the Stronghold falls silent as merchants vanish without trace. Wagons lie overturned and their goods rot in the rain. The search for bandits leads to the edge of the forest where a simple band of goblins seems, at first glance, to be the cause of the disappearances.

In the heart of the Urrak Markets, the goatmen barter lives for orcish promises of enchanted steel and dark sorcery. Beneath the noise of trade, something far grimmer moves. The orc clans prepare their captives for sacrifice, their rituals meant to rouse the demon god Baphumos from his slumber within the forsaken Demonbrand Ruins.

Far in the frostbitten north, the port of Drakheim howls with warcries. Bleakfrost Orcs surge across its frozen shores, enslaving the weak and spilling blood in the name of their drowned god. What was once a peaceful harbor shared by eldrin and humans now serves as a sacrificial altar to the abyss.

Dark omens gather above the sea. The tide rises red with sacrifice, and the chants of the Bleakfrost echo through ruined streets. If the ritual completes, the depths will awaken, and the god beneath the waves will claim the coast in hunger and ice.
